title: audio_export_range
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.11) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_exportAudio + kalam-prd.md §7.1 kalam_exportAudio (Addendum A2: one shared host service), Hush FR-3, FR-4, Kalam FR-3; not routed yet. Upstream: adobe/tools/hush/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:101 HUSH.exportAudio (entry hush_exportAudio :331); adobe/tools/kalam/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:92 KALAM.exportAudio (entry kalam_exportAudio :208). CEP WNC_AUDIO.exportRange (signed bridge). Contract keys are snake_case; the port translates the upstream camelCase keys (docs/adobe/phase-6b-reservations.md). Export a sequence range's audio to a WAV through exportAsMediaDirect with Premiere's own 48 kHz mono 16-bit preset (Wave48mono16.epr; the host finds it, Hush's extDir argument is dropped): every audio track not listed is muted for the export and its mute state restored after, In/Out are set to the range and restored, in finally. Premiere may append '.wav' to the file name; the readback names the file written.

items.description: track index, 0-based (Premiere's DOM order; upstream error messages say V<index + 1>)

audio_tracks.description: the ticked audio tracks (upstream `audioTracks`; Hush FR-3, Kalam FR-3); every other audio track is muted during the export, then restored

data.description: {out_path,start,end,audio_tracks} (Hush and Kalam send the same four; Hush's extDir is not kept).

path.description: the WAV written, native path (File.fsName); may end in an appended '.wav'

start.description: the range start, echoed, sequence seconds

end.description: the range end, echoed, sequence seconds

preset.description: the .epr used (Hush returns it; Kalam does not)

readback.description: {path,start,end,preset?}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.
